vulnerable_code:
class Banking::WireTemplatesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_customer!

  def create
    # Permits foreign key user_id from client request
    @template = WireTemplate.new(template_params)
    @template.save!
    render json: @template, status: :created
  end

  private

  def template_params
    params.require(:wire_template).permit(:recipient_iban, :swift_bic, :user_id, :template_name)
  end
end
diagnosis: The controller permits user_id in strong parameters instead of associating the wire template with current_customer. An attacker can insert fraudulent pre-approved wire transfer destination templates into other bank customers' accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/banking/wire_templates HTTP/1.1
Host: banking.secure-online.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_token_882
Content-Type: application/json

{"wire_template": {"recipient_iban": "GB29NWBK60161331926819", "swift_bic": "NWBKGB2L", "user_id": 772, "template_name": "Payroll"}}
corrected_code:
class Banking::WireTemplatesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_customer!

  def create
    @template = current_customer.wire_templates.build(template_params)
    @template.save!
    render json: @template, status: :created
  end

  private

  def template_params
    params.require(:wire_template).permit(:recipient_iban, :swift_bic, :template_name)
  end
end
